items.title: Updating encryption on existing Amazon S3 objects with S3 Batch Operations
items.summary: Large organizations accumulate billions of Amazon S3 objects under different encryption configurations. Learn how to use S3 Batch Operations with the new UpdateObjectEncryption API to standardize encryption across an entire bucket at scale. The approach moves objects from SSE-S3 to SSE-KMS in place, with no data movement and without breaking S3 Lifecycle policies.
items.creator: Rohit Rajput
